original_frontmatter.name: 3d-cloth-material
original_frontmatter.description: Build convincing woven cloth in Three.js, with a thread-level weave normal map, sheen and anisotropic highlights, folds that never stretch the texture, hems with thickness, stitches, seams, frayed edges, fold occlusion, dye and wear variation, and light passing through thin fabric. Use for linen, silk, wool, canvas, curtains, banners, cloaks, tablecloths, tapestries or any 3D drape that currently looks like a plastic sheet, a stretched texture, or a flat coloured plane.
